wall_thickness_differential.why: a grey rectangle and a smaller red rectangle with a dashed border, with dimension lines indicating a total width of 25mm and a reduced width of 22mm
wall_thickness_differential.subject: A close-up cross-section of the steel wall showing a 25mm block shrinking to 22mm as an 'acid' layer eats into the interior surface.
wall_thickness_differential.title: Corrosion Allowance Deficit

stress_concentration_heatmap.why: A schematic nozzle outline with horizontal red lines curving and bunching into sharp inner corners, overlaid with glowing heat-map spots.
stress_concentration_heatmap.subject: A heat-map overlay on a nozzle weld showing stress lines bunching and turning bright red at the sharp interior corners.
stress_concentration_heatmap.title: Nozzle Stress Concentration

comparison_diagram.why: one continuous horizontal red bar on the left and two shorter horizontal yellow bars separated by a gap on the right
comparison_diagram.subject: Side-by-side animation comparing the single rod design versus the two-rod modification.
comparison_diagram.title: Modification Comparison

thermal_gradient_map.why: на кадре видно «a single flat reddish-orange rectangle outlined in white, a dashed yellow line underneath it, and text labels above and below»; не хватает: The drawing consists of a single flat-colored block without any color gradient shifting from blue to red, heat radiation arrows, or distinct layers representing the steam jacket and steel wall.
thermal_gradient_map.subject: A cross-section showing heat radiating from the steam jacket into the steel wall, with a color gradient shifting from blue (cold) to red (hot).
thermal_gradient_map.title: Heating the Reactor Shell

vessel_cross_section.why: a vessel outline containing a dark filled region for liquid level, small yellow dots inside, an inlet pipe at the bottom, and a 20 FT height dimension line
vessel_cross_section.subject: the diagram is named "vessel cross section" — the drawing must show exactly that

thermal_gradient_cross_section.why: на кадре видно «a horizontal rectangle divided into a flat reddish section containing a yellow dot and a flat dark gray section, with a text label 'Yield Strength: 50 MPa' and an L-shaped line beneath.»; не хватает: The drawing shows flat solid colors and a yield strength label, missing any thermal color gradient, temperature values, or cross-sectional layer details.
thermal_gradient_cross_section.subject: the diagram is named "thermal gradient cross section" — the drawing must show exactly that

structural_load_distribution.why: A rectangular block representing a raft sitting on a larger rectangular block representing soil, with five identical yellow arrows pointing downward from the raft into the soil.
structural_load_distribution.subject: Show a cross-section of the raft foundation with arrows radiating downward to represent the pressure being spread evenly across the soil.
structural_load_distribution.title: Foundation Load Distribution

geological_cross_section.why: A vertical stack of four distinct rectangular colored layers, with horizontal dashed lines separating the middle layers and leader lines pointing to each section.
geological_cross_section.subject: A cross-section diagram showing labeled layers of soil, highlighting the specific dense clay layer beneath the foundation.
geological_cross_section.title: Soil Composition

force_vector_diagram.why: A white rectangle with three horizontal arrows pointing outward from each side and three vertical arrows pointing downward from the bottom edge.
force_vector_diagram.subject: Display the silo with arrows pushing outward on the walls (lateral) and downward into the ground (vertical) to visualize the dual stress.
force_vector_diagram.title: Lateral vs Vertical Forces

borehole_data_map.why: A vertical column divided into four colored layers (brown, beige, blue, and dark grey) with a depth scale on the left ranging from 0m to 31.25m, where the blue layer is highlighted with a red dashed outline and a pointer label reading '16m: Soft Blue'.
borehole_data_map.subject: Show a vertical borehole diagram highlighting the 'soft blue clay' layer at 16 meters that the engineers ignored.
borehole_data_map.title: Hidden Soil Risk

differential_settlement_view.why: A rectangular area divided by a diagonal dashed line, with a vertical axis on the left labeled with depth measurements (0cm, 40cm, 80cm, 120cm) and labels for 'SOUTH' and 'NORTH' sides.
differential_settlement_view.subject: A simple diagram comparing the depth of the north and south sides of the foundation to show the initiation of the tilt.
differential_settlement_view.title: Uneven Sinking

shear_plane_lubrication.why: Two offset grey rectangular blocks labeled 'RDEN' and 'BASE' with a thin yellow horizontal layer labeled 'VEIN' between them, containing a red arrow labeled 'SHEAR FORCE', and a friction scale at the bottom reading 'FRICTION: 0.43'.
shear_plane_lubrication.subject: A zoom-in on the shear plane showing the thin clay vein acting as a 'slip' layer, reducing friction between the raft and the earth.
shear_plane_lubrication.title: Subterranean Lubrication
